author: Zephyr I
title: Late dual-head time injection — Dilation=3 (std-width nodil, BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Ablate spatial receptive field: switch dilation from 5 to 3 on the main CNN convs while keeping undilated bottlenecks, late dual-head time injection, and double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64). BASE_SEED=42.
